subject: Subject: A precise top-down educational comparison within ONE image: on the left a simple cooktop with EXACTLY FOUR circular burners arranged in a 2 x 2 square; beside it on the right EXACTLY FOUR rotary control knobs in the SAME 2 x 2 square arrangement and SAME orientation. Both grids have four equally separated positions. The LOWER-LEFT burner is highlighted by a solid pale lime disc; the LOWER-LEFT knob is highlighted in the same lime and appears selected. The other three burners and three knobs remain neutral white. A single thin bent connector joins the selected lower-left knob to the corresponding lower-left burner without obscuring the other objects. This is a spatial mapping diagram: knob positions reproduce burner positions. No extra controls, burners, flames, people or decorative objects. No words, letters or numbers. Make the two corresponding grids unambiguous, broad and readable.
